spec.rawSql:
with periods as (
    select 'Standing charges' as prices, metering_point_id, start_of_contract, end_of_contract
    from master_energy_contract_pricing_fixed
    union
    select 'Energy prices', metering_point_id, start_of_contract, end_of_contract
    from master_energy_contract_pricing_variable
), ordered as (
    select p.*, lag(p.end_of_contract) over (partition by p.prices, p.metering_point_id order by p.start_of_contract) as previous_end
    from periods p
)
select o.prices,
       m.name || case when m.feeding then ' (feed-in)' else ' (consumption)' end as metering_point,
       to_char((o.previous_end + interval '1 second') at time zone m.timezone, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as gap_from,
       to_char((o.start_of_contract - interval '1 second') at time zone m.timezone, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as gap_to,
       round(extract(epoch from o.start_of_contract - o.previous_end) / 86400.0, 1) as days
from ordered o
join master_smartmeter_metering_point m on m.id = o.metering_point_id
where o.start_of_contract - o.previous_end > interval '1 second'
order by o.prices, o.metering_point_id, o.start_of_contract;

spec.description: Times without a price between two periods of the same metering point (period ends at 23:59:59 and the next starts at 00:00:00 count as no gap). Empty when everything is covered.
spec.title: Gaps between price periods

spec.rawSql:
select f.id,
       f.metering_point_id,
       m.name || case when m.feeding then ' (feed-in)' else ' (consumption)' end as metering_point,
       f.name,
       f.price,
       f.price * 365 as price_per_year,
       f.pricing_base,
       f.comment,
       to_char(f.start_of_contract at time zone m.timezone, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as valid_from,
       case when f.end_of_contract = 'infinity' then '' else to_char(f.end_of_contract at time zone m.timezone, 'YYYY-MM-DD') end as valid_to
from master_energy_contract_pricing_fixed f
join master_smartmeter_metering_point m on m.id = f.metering_point_id
order by f.metering_point_id, f.start_of_contract desc;

spec.description: master_energy_contract_pricing_fixed: base fees per day, including VAT. Adding a row from a date ends the row that runs on that date the day before.
spec.title: Standing charges

payload.rawSql:
with m as (
    select id, timezone, ${payload.valid_from:sqlstring}::date::timestamp at time zone timezone as start_ts
    from master_smartmeter_metering_point
    where id = ${payload.metering_point_id}
), closed as (
    update master_energy_contract_pricing_fixed f
    set end_of_contract = m.start_ts - interval '1 second'
    from m
    where f.metering_point_id = m.id
      and f.contractrange @> m.start_ts
      and f.start_of_contract < m.start_ts
    returning f.id
)
insert into master_energy_contract_pricing_fixed (metering_point_id, name, price, pricing_base, comment, start_of_contract, end_of_contract)
select m.id, ${payload.name:sqlstring}, ${payload.price}, 'per_day', ${payload.comment:sqlstring}, m.start_ts, coalesce((nullif(${payload.valid_to:sqlstring}, '')::date + interval '23:59:59')::timestamp at time zone m.timezone, 'infinity')
from m;

update master_energy_contract_pricing_fixed f
set name = ${payload.name:sqlstring},
    price = ${payload.price},
    pricing_base = ${payload.pricing_base:sqlstring},
    comment = ${payload.comment:sqlstring},
    start_of_contract = ${payload.valid_from:sqlstring}::date::timestamp at time zone m.timezone,
    end_of_contract = coalesce((nullif(${payload.valid_to:sqlstring}, '')::date + interval '23:59:59')::timestamp at time zone m.timezone, 'infinity')
from master_smartmeter_metering_point m
where m.id = f.metering_point_id
  and f.id = ${payload.id};

spec.rawSql:
select v.metering_point_id,
       m.name || case when m.feeding then ' (feed-in)' else ' (consumption)' end as metering_point,
       v.start_of_contract::text || '|' || v.end_of_contract::text as period_key,
       to_char(v.start_of_contract at time zone m.timezone, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as valid_from,
       case when v.end_of_contract = 'infinity' then '' else to_char(v.end_of_contract at time zone m.timezone, 'YYYY-MM-DD') end as valid_to,
       bool_and(v.spot_tarif) as spot_tarif,
       max(v.disagio) as disagio,
       coalesce(string_agg(distinct nullif(v.comment, ''), ' / '), '') as comment,
       count(*) as slots,
       min(v.price) as min_price,
       max(v.price) as max_price
from master_energy_contract_pricing_variable v
join master_smartmeter_metering_point m on m.id = v.metering_point_id
group by v.metering_point_id, m.name, m.feeding, m.timezone, v.start_of_contract, v.end_of_contract
order by v.metering_point_id, v.start_of_contract desc;

spec.description: master_energy_contract_pricing_variable, one row per contract period. Adding a period from a date copies all slots of the latest period starting before that date and, if it still runs, ends it the day before; then change the prices in Energy prices. Editing a period changes all of its slots.
spec.title: Energy price periods

payload.rawSql:
with m as (
    select id, timezone, ${payload.valid_from:sqlstring}::date::timestamp at time zone timezone as start_ts
    from master_smartmeter_metering_point
    where id = ${payload.metering_point_id}
), src as (
    select v.*
    from master_energy_contract_pricing_variable v
    join m on m.id = v.metering_point_id
    where v.start_of_contract = (select max(p.start_of_contract)
                                 from master_energy_contract_pricing_variable p
                                 where p.metering_point_id = m.id
                                   and p.start_of_contract < m.start_ts)
), closed as (
    update master_energy_contract_pricing_variable v
    set end_of_contract = m.start_ts - interval '1 second'
    from m
    where v.id in (select id from src)
      and v.end_of_contract >= m.start_ts
    returning v.id
)
insert into master_energy_contract_pricing_variable (metering_point_id, day_of_week, time_of_start, time_of_end, price, spot_tarif, disagio, comment, start_of_contract, end_of_contract)
select src.metering_point_id, src.day_of_week, src.time_of_start, src.time_of_end, src.price, src.spot_tarif, src.disagio, src.comment, m.start_ts,
       case when src.end_of_contract >= m.start_ts then src.end_of_contract else 'infinity' end
from src, m;

update master_energy_contract_pricing_variable v
set start_of_contract = ${payload.valid_from:sqlstring}::date::timestamp at time zone m.timezone,
    end_of_contract = coalesce((nullif(${payload.valid_to:sqlstring}, '')::date + interval '23:59:59')::timestamp at time zone m.timezone, 'infinity'),
    spot_tarif = ${payload.spot_tarif},
    disagio = ${payload.disagio},
    comment = case
                  when ${payload.comment:sqlstring} = (select coalesce(string_agg(distinct nullif(p.comment, ''), ' / '), '')
                                                        from master_energy_contract_pricing_variable p
                                                        where p.metering_point_id = v.metering_point_id
                                                          and p.start_of_contract::text || '|' || p.end_of_contract::text = ${payload.period_key:sqlstring})
                      then v.comment
                  else ${payload.comment:sqlstring}
              end
from master_smartmeter_metering_point m
where m.id = v.metering_point_id
  and v.metering_point_id = ${payload.metering_point_id}
  and v.start_of_contract::text || '|' || v.end_of_contract::text = ${payload.period_key:sqlstring};

spec.rawSql:
select v.id,
       v.metering_point_id,
       m.name || case when m.feeding then ' (feed-in)' else ' (consumption)' end as metering_point,
       to_char(v.start_of_contract at time zone m.timezone, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as valid_from,
       case when v.end_of_contract = 'infinity' then '' else to_char(v.end_of_contract at time zone m.timezone, 'YYYY-MM-DD') end as valid_to,
       v.day_of_week,
       to_char(v.time_of_start, 'HH24:MI:SS') as time_of_start,
       to_char(v.time_of_end, 'HH24:MI:SS') as time_of_end,
       v.price,
       v.spot_tarif,
       v.disagio,
       v.comment
from master_energy_contract_pricing_variable v
join master_smartmeter_metering_point m on m.id = v.metering_point_id
order by v.metering_point_id, v.start_of_contract desc, v.day_of_week, v.time_of_start;

select d as value, to_char(date '2024-01-01' + d - 1, 'Dy') as label
from generate_series(1, 7) d;

spec.description: master_energy_contract_pricing_variable, one row per weekday and time slot. Times are local and both ends are included (00:00:00 to 23:59:59 is the whole day). A new slot joins the period that runs on its Valid from date, or starts an open period there.
spec.title: Energy prices

payload.rawSql:
with m as (
    select id, timezone, ${payload.valid_from:sqlstring}::date::timestamp at time zone timezone as start_ts
    from master_smartmeter_metering_point
    where id = ${payload.metering_point_id}
), p as (
    select v.start_of_contract, v.end_of_contract, v.spot_tarif, v.disagio
    from master_energy_contract_pricing_variable v
    join m on m.id = v.metering_point_id
    where v.contractrange @> m.start_ts
    order by v.id
    limit 1
)
insert into master_energy_contract_pricing_variable (metering_point_id, day_of_week, time_of_start, time_of_end, price, comment, spot_tarif, disagio, start_of_contract, end_of_contract)
select m.id, ${payload.day_of_week}, ${payload.time_of_start:sqlstring}::time, ${payload.time_of_end:sqlstring}::time, ${payload.price},
       ${payload.comment:sqlstring},
       coalesce(p.spot_tarif, false), coalesce(p.disagio, 0), coalesce(p.start_of_contract, m.start_ts), coalesce(p.end_of_contract, 'infinity')
from m
left join p on true;

update master_energy_contract_pricing_variable
set day_of_week = ${payload.day_of_week},
    time_of_start = ${payload.time_of_start:sqlstring}::time,
    time_of_end = ${payload.time_of_end:sqlstring}::time,
    price = ${payload.price},
    comment = ${payload.comment:sqlstring}
where id = ${payload.id};

spec.rawSql:
with m as materialized (select * from agg_1month_what_if),
pv as (select * from m where month >= (select date_trunc('month', min(date)) from master_pv_investition)),
roi as (select cumulative_pv_investment as cumulative_cost,
               cumulative_pv_investment - cumulative_saved_pv as open_sum,
               (select avg(saved_pv) from pv) as average_saved,
               (now() + interval '1 month' * ((cumulative_pv_investment - cumulative_saved_pv) / nullif((select avg(saved_pv) from pv), 0)))::date as time_of_roi
        from m order by month desc limit 1),
metered as (select * from m where price_actual is not null),
since as (select to_char(min(month), 'YYYY-MM') as car, (select to_char(min(month), 'YYYY-MM') from pv) as pv,
                 to_char(max(month) filter (where estimated), 'YYYY-MM') as estimated_until from m)
select 1 as nr, '1. Energy without PV' as item, (select sum(price_without_pv) from pv) as eur,
       'every kWh the household used bought at the hour''s price, since ' || since.pv || ' (energy only, no standing charges)' as note from since
union all select 2, '   Energy actually paid', (select sum(price_actual) from pv), 'grid import minus feed-in' from since
union all select 3, '   PV saved', (select sum(saved_pv) from pv), '' from since
union all select 4, '2. Fuel for the reference car', (select sum(price_fuel) from m),
       'since ' || since.car || ', until ' || since.estimated_until || ' estimated from the odometer' from since
union all select 5, '   EV''s grid energy', (select sum(price_car) from m), 'home charging, the house takes the PV first, PV energy into the car free' from since
union all select 6, '   EV saved', (select sum(saved_ev) from m),
       (select round(sum(saved_ev) filter (where estimated)::numeric) || ' € of it estimated' from m) from since
union all select 7, '3. PV investment', roi.cumulative_cost, 'master_pv_investition' from roi
union all select 8, '   PV still open', roi.open_sum,
       'paid back around ' || to_char(roi.time_of_roi, 'YYYY-MM') || ' at the average saving so far (' || round(roi.average_saved::numeric) || ' € per month)' from roi
union all select 9, '4. No PV and a combustion car', (select sum(price_house_without_pv + price_fuel) from metered) + (select coalesce(sum(price_fuel), 0) from m where price_actual is null),
       'the house without the car from the grid, plus fuel' from since
union all select 10, '   Actually paid, car included', (select sum(price_actual) from metered) + (select coalesce(sum(price_car), 0) from m where price_actual is null), '' from since
union all select 11, '   PV and EV saved', (select sum(saved_both) from m), 'the car''s PV energy counted once' from since
order by nr;

spec.description: agg_1month_what_if: what PV, the EV and both together have saved, against what it would have cost without them. Energy only: standing charges, maintenance, tax and insurance are left out.
spec.title: Savings in total

spec.description: agg_1month_what_if: PV = self-consumption at the consumption price plus feed-in; EV = fuel for the reference car minus the car's grid energy at the hour's price (house first, PV energy into the car free); PV and EV = no PV and a combustion car against the actual bill, the overlap counted once. Months up to February 2024 are estimated for the EV.
spec.title: Savings per month

spec.description: agg_1year_what_if, the same as per month. 2022 is only December.
spec.title: Savings per year

spec.description: Running totals from agg_1month_what_if, each at the start of its month.
spec.title: Savings over time against the PV investment

spec.rawSql:
select to_char(month, 'YYYY-MM') as month,
       estimated,
       km,
       litres,
       price_fuel,
       energy_car,
       energy_car_pv,
       price_car,
       price_without_pv,
       price_actual,
       saved_pv,
       saved_ev,
       saved_both
from agg_1month_what_if
order by month desc;

spec.description: agg_1month_what_if. energy_car is the go-e energy (charging losses included), energy_car_pv its PV share with the house served first. price_without_pv and price_actual are empty where the smart meter has no complete day.
spec.title: Per month

spec.rawSql:
select r.id,
       r.name,
       r.fuel_type,
       r.consumption,
       r.comment,
       to_char(r.valid_from at time zone z.timezone, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as valid_from,
       case when r.valid_to = 'infinity' then '' else to_char(r.valid_to at time zone z.timezone, 'YYYY-MM-DD') end as valid_to
from master_reference_car r
cross join (select timezone from master_smartmeter_metering_point order by id limit 1) z
order by r.valid_from desc;

spec.description: master_reference_car: the combustion car the EV is compared with, per period, in litres per 100 km. Fuel type DIE (diesel) or SUP (Super 95). Adding a row from a date ends the row that runs on that date the day before.
spec.title: Reference car

payload.rawSql:
with s as (
    select ${payload.valid_from:sqlstring}::date::timestamp at time zone (select timezone from master_smartmeter_metering_point order by id limit 1) as start_ts
), closed as (
    update master_reference_car r
    set valid_to = s.start_ts - interval '1 second'
    from s
    where r.validrange @> s.start_ts
      and r.valid_from < s.start_ts
    returning r.id
)
insert into master_reference_car (vehicle_id, name, fuel_type, consumption, comment, valid_from, valid_to)
select (select min(id) from master_vehicles where purchased_on is not null), ${payload.name:sqlstring}, ${payload.fuel_type:sqlstring}, ${payload.consumption}, ${payload.comment:sqlstring}, s.start_ts,
       coalesce((nullif(${payload.valid_to:sqlstring}, '')::date + interval '23:59:59')::timestamp at time zone (select timezone from master_smartmeter_metering_point order by id limit 1), 'infinity')
from s;

update master_reference_car r
set name = ${payload.name:sqlstring},
    fuel_type = ${payload.fuel_type:sqlstring},
    consumption = ${payload.consumption},
    comment = ${payload.comment:sqlstring},
    valid_from = ${payload.valid_from:sqlstring}::date::timestamp at time zone (select timezone from master_smartmeter_metering_point order by id limit 1),
    valid_to = coalesce((nullif(${payload.valid_to:sqlstring}, '')::date + interval '23:59:59')::timestamp at time zone (select timezone from master_smartmeter_metering_point order by id limit 1), 'infinity')
where r.id = ${payload.id};

spec.description: master_vehicles: when the EV was bought and its odometer then. The months before the first odometer reading (2024-02-26) are estimated from these.
spec.title: Electric car
